title: DW-30…DW-44 - Deesys 3-Phase Current Transformer (combined 2CT / 3CT), 1150 V
description: Deesys three-phase current transformer combining the individual CTs of all phases into one moulded body, so a single part covers a 3P3W (2CT) or 3P4W (3CT) circuit — faster to install and cheaper than separate CTs. Window (busbar/cable-through) type, polycarbonate case. Series: DW-30…DW-34 for 3P3W 2CT and DW-40…DW-44 for 3P4W 3CT.
